notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 - QoL improvements!
notes.content:
Here's a day 1 patch that should hopefully make Hexvade that little bit more enjoyable! Just a small one, but it's something to get us started!

+ The cursor now hides itself on screens that do not use the cursor to avoid obstructing play
+ You can now press ESC (or Select on controller) to pause the game in singleplayer.
- Removed debug feature which froze the player if you pressed 'K'
* Fixed crash when dying during a bosses death animation

Any more suggestions be sure to make yourself heard and they'll be considered for the next patch!
Hope you're all enjoying the game! :)
